description: Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act (1990) (as amended) seeking a Minor Material Amendment to vary Condition 2 (Approved Drawings and Documents), to allow for an increase in the roof parapet height attached to planning permission 215293VAR dated 13 October 2021 which granted planning permission for: 'Application for a Minor Material Amendment (S73a) seeking the raising the proposed floor slabs to align with existing floor slabs for structural stability, redesigned stairs in accordance to floor level change and minor alterations to 2F flat layout to accommodate housing standards and set back pursuant to planning permission ref: 202071FUL dated 12.11.2020 for: 'First and second floor rear extensions to accommodate 2 self-contained residential units; and provision of associated separate access, cycle storage and refuse storage (following the demolition of part of the exiting building)'
